headings.text: Two paths exist at the head of this PR.
A new host-facing path is available.
The old route is still connected ↗
The first answer ends the search ↗
A missing answer is not permission to replay ↗
What must a host know now?
The runtime boundary stays a socket and a worker thread.
A new owner is not yet a new consumer.
Starting, but also the wrong version.
What did the daemon already accept?
One owner decides which coordinates count.
The clock’s owner changes. The idle reset event does not.
The new witnesses see different boundaries.
Timing assertions leave the worker scenario.
The clock scan sees only its neighbors.
The harness makes two other choices.

controls.text:
D01
Give hosts execute and typed control reports
STATED

Hosts supply environment, executor factory + module URL, readiness probe, and classified requests. The client returns output + mode or a lifecycle report.

reason + evidence ↗

D02
Keep declarations free of Node types
STATED

The façade dynamically loads its Node runtime during construction. Portable declarations do not make execution browser-compatible.

reason + evidence ↗

D03
Package the process and worker around injected execution
STATED

The package owns executable entries and private mechanisms; the host executor still supplies product behavior. The daemon imports no other production symnav package.

reason + evidence ↗

D04
Keep the shipped CLI on its compatibility graph
STATED

The dispatcher and lifecycle registration remain byte-identical to the base. This PR adds the package path; it does not switch those consumers.

reason + evidence ↗

D05
Freeze 38 app-local mechanism files
STATED

A path-and-content hash freezes the compatibility graph after preparation. It normalizes CRLF; dispatcher, route, and workspace selector are excluded.

reason + evidence ↗

D06
Group mechanisms by the concern they own
STATED

Client, process, registry, transport, execution, delivery, worker, resources, diagnostics, and lifecycle become package folders. The coordinator is renamed before copying.

reason + evidence ↗

D07
Use four ordered, lazy routing guards
STATED

Record present → not starting → version → responsive. Read and observation are memoized; a decision prevents every later guard and its effects.

reason + evidence ↗

D08
Keep the route and local-execution distinctions
STATED

Disabled, absent, starting, or recovering run cold; ready/busy run warm; dead/incompatible fall back. Only absent/fallback routing decisions trigger independent warmup. Local attempts get fresh executors. Errors and exact-process cleanup keep their distinct routes.

reason + evidence ↗

D09
Compose lifecycle once, with a separate status timeout
STATED

Disabled blocks start; status and stop still operate. The host supplies the readiness command, which still runs through execution. Control failures reject to the host wrapper.

reason + evidence ↗

D10
Let transport retry-safety authorize fallback
STATED

A retry-safe warm submission failure gets one local fallback. An uncertain or accepted failure stays warm and produces a controlled failure instead of replay.

reason + evidence ↗

D11
Own warm output capture inside the package
STATED

Each transfer gets a fresh policy-limited capture, using memory then an OS-temporary spool. The returned output still has records() and dispose(); the host does not provide capture factories.

reason + evidence ↗

D12
Own failure output and malformed-result cleanup
STATED

Resource, response-capacity, and incomplete-request failures become stderr + exit 1. A missing output or non-integer exit code is incomplete; any available malformed output is disposed.

reason + evidence ↗

D13
Validate adopted coordinates inside the coordinator
UNEXPLAINED

The renamed coordinator takes coordinates, a serving port, a workspace-exists callback, and an explicit clock. Identity mismatches fail before component setup; that placement has no stated rationale.

reason + evidence ↗

D14
Give registry startup equality one owner
STATED

Callers request named identity/instance/token/PID checks. One predicate compares the requested coordinates; exact-owner cleanup also compares timestamps and revision.

reason + evidence ↗

D15
Pin the existing authentication order and exceptions
UNEXPLAINED

Execution checks protocol/instance before token. Identify/terminate/kill use identity credentials; ping/stop still omit token checks. No reason for that asymmetry was found.

reason + evidence ↗

D16
Use a daemon-owned clock API
STATED

Daemon mechanisms stop using telemetry clocks and raw time sources. Wall time still owns persisted/lifetime deadlines; monotonic time owns elapsed execution and queue measurements.

reason + evidence ↗

D17
Defer readiness- and completion-based idle timing
STATED

Idle time starts in the constructor and resets at navigation acceptance. Long startup or a long completed turn can exhaust it. Ready/completion resets are written down as future behavior.

reason + evidence ↗

D18
Move 37 mechanism test files into the daemon package
STATED

Package tests use generic executor fixtures and local helpers, including standalone module fixtures and tsx tooling. CLI product behavior stays with CLI tests.

reason + evidence ↗

D19
Narrow the relocated worker test
UNEXPLAINED

Generic readiness replaces the CLI version scenario and drops startup/execution duration assertions. Version rejection returns as a direct CLI-factory test, losing the former worker-initialization assertion.

reason + evidence ↗

D20
Replace the mocked CLI entry tests with built-entry evidence
STATED

The CLI entry test file is deleted. New package tests exercise compiled worker, launcher, process initialization, and cleanup. They test a different boundary, not the same mock assertions.

reason + evidence ↗

D21
Retire policy-testing exports and their lint guard
UNEXPLAINED

The export map becomes root + two side-effect-only entries. Policy helpers move to test folders; the old import restriction and its positive/negative tests are deleted.

reason + evidence ↗

D22
Add a clock-ownership scan limited to one folder
UNEXPLAINED

The new test scans only siblings of lifecycle/daemon-clock.test.ts. Process, registry, worker, and execution folders are outside its scope.

reason + evidence ↗

D23
Disable parallel execution of package test files
UNEXPLAINED

The new Vitest configuration sets fileParallelism: false. No explanation accompanies this choice.

reason + evidence ↗

D24
Give Windows termination a different cleanup assertion
UNEXPLAINED

The built-process test permits a retained record and absent termination diagnostic on Windows, then has its caller remove the exited record. Other platforms expect process cleanup.
